description: Look up Brazilian companies by CNPJ in bulk, or discover companies by CNAE, state, city, legal nature or partner. Returns official Receita Federal registry data and full partner (QSA) records.

cnaes.description: One or more 7-digit CNAE codes (mode=discovery). Matches primary or secondary activity. Example: ["6209100", "6201501"].
cnaes.title: CNAE codes

cnpjText.description: Paste a CSV or any text containing CNPJs (mode=lookup). Every valid CNPJ is extracted, validated and deduplicated. A spreadsheet column with or without a header works.
cnpjText.title: CNPJ list or CSV text

cnpjs.description: CNPJ numbers to look up (mode=lookup). Numeric or alphanumeric, formatted or plain. Example: ["18.236.120/0001-58", "00000000E08G12"].
cnpjs.title: CNPJ numbers

includeSecondaryActivities.description: Include the list of secondary CNAE activities.
includeSecondaryActivities.title: Include secondary CNAEs

maxItems.description: Maximum CNPJs to process in lookup, or maximum records to emit in discovery.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Look up a list of CNPJs, or discover companies that match filters.
mode.title: Mode

municipio.description: IBGE or SIAFI municipality code, digits only (mode=discovery). Example: 3550308 (São Paulo), 5300108 (Brasília). This is a code, not a city name.
municipio.title: Municipality code

naturezaJuridica.description: 4-digit legal-nature code (mode=discovery). Example: 2135 (Empresário Individual), 2062 (Sociedade Empresária Limitada).
naturezaJuridica.title: Legal nature code

partnerCpf.description: Masked partner document from the QSA (mode=discovery), in the Receita format such as ***123456**. Add a state or CNAE to narrow the search; the same mask can match different people.
partnerCpf.title: Partner CPF/CNPJ

situacao.description: Keep only companies with this registration status (mode=discovery).
situacao.title: Registration status

title: Brazilian CNPJ Lookup Input
